intro: Lesson 32: The first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah: Hajj, Arafah and udhiyah. Plan or write in each box.

parts.label: Point
parts.text: the time starts after the Eid prayer.

parts.label: Evidence
parts.text: the Prophet ﷺ said the first thing on this day is to pray, then sacrifice; whoever slaughtered before the prayer must offer another (Bukhari and Muslim).
